lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of small, high-luminance circular blobs is located immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a more sparse, grid-like arrangement of larger circular maxima along the mid-flank, positioned primarily between the horizontal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal carinae, forming a faint grid where circular blobs are localized within the resulting rectangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient, with high-intensity light on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge, running parallel from the post-branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast, slender linear feature (biological hitchhiker) is visible immediately ventral to the pectoral fin's insertion point; dense, small-diameter spotting is visible across the entire surface of the pectoral fin.
